map.电阻焊和弧焊区别？: What is the difference between resistance welding and arc welding?
map.电阻焊靠接触电阻通电加热加压，无填充金属、快、适合薄板批量；弧焊有电弧与焊丝，适: Resistance welding heats by contact resistance under pressure, no filler metal, fast and suited to thin-plate mass production; arc welding has an arc and wire, suited to thick plate and all-position welding.
map.铝为什么难焊？: Why is aluminum hard to weld?
map.铝氧化膜高熔、导热快、易氢孔，需交流 TIG 破膜或 MIG 脉冲，并严格清理与: Aluminum has a high-melting oxide film, fast heat conduction and hydrogen-porosity tendency, requiring AC TIG to break the film or pulsed MIG, plus strict cleaning and shielding gas.
